name: BENT OVER DUMBBELL ROWS LEFT
introduce: Put your right knee and right hand on the bench and your left leg out to the side.\n\nGrab the dumbbell with your left hand, slowly lift it up to your armpit and then lower it. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your neck in a neutral position.
Exhale as pulling the dumbbell up, inhale when lowering it.
